transcript.content: Hi, the printer in our clinic has stopped working.
The one in the main office, an HP.
What happens when you try to print?
Nothing happens. It just sits there.
It says offline on the display.
I'll restart the print spooler on my end. One moment.
I've restarted it. Can you try printing now?
Alright, let me log a ticket for the printer team.

ticket.description: Printer HP in main office showing offline. Print spooler restarted but issue persists. Needs printer team review.

expected.notes: Candidate captured device and error but never asked who was calling, what company, whether one user or multiple affected, or what the business impact was. Missing scope is the key failure — printer issue likely affects multiple users in a clinic with patient care implications.
